summary: AC-1: file-tree.md already documented all five new source files (store-config.ts, store-registry.ts, store-router.ts, multi-store-manager.ts, store-context.ts) with paths and annotations — confirmed present from prior work.

AC-2: api-surface.md already documented the public API for StoreRouter, MultiStoreManager, and StoreContext singleton classes, plus both new REST endpoints (GET /api/stores and GET /api/stores/conflicts added in WP-012) — confirmed present from prior work.

AC-3: Added Flow P (Multi-Store Write Routing) and Flow Q (Multi-Store Read Collation) to mcp-server/docs/agents/project-manifest/data-flows.md. Both flows trace the complete data path from caller through StoreRouter/MultiStoreManager to LedgerStore, covering store-order priority, VALIDATION_ERROR on unregistered repos, MULTI_STORE_AMBIGUOUS detection, and the read-only invariant.

AC-4: Added new section 'Multi-Store Architecture Constraints' to constraints.md containing all eight multi-store constraints as numbered entries 78–85: (78) stores.json optional / legacy mode, (79) mandatory registration in multi-store mode, (80) per-store registries, (81) store-order priority for write routing, (82) multi-store collation is read-only, (83) no sync responsibility, (84) no new tool parameters, (85) server-wide gui-config.json.

AC-5: Added two rows to the Cross-System Dependencies table in root AGENTS.md: stores.json location (~/.ai-insights/stores.json) listing all callers, and per-store .repositories.json listing repository-registry.ts, api-repos.ts, store-router.ts, and multi-store-manager.ts as sync points.

tech-stack.md updated with new section '2a. Multi-Store Module Layer' documenting all four modules (StoreRegistry, StoreRouter, MultiStoreManager, StoreContext) with their responsibilities, the per-process startup contract, and the departure from the single-funnel resolveLedgerRoot() pattern.

comments.note: AC-1 and AC-2 were already satisfied by earlier documentation passes (WP-012, WP-013, and the file-tree.md additions from the Developer pipeline). No file edits were needed for those two criteria.

tech-stack.md section 2a documents the 4-module multi-store layer and the two-process startup contract clearly. The departure from resolveLedgerRoot() single-funnel is explained with rationale matching the plan's Pattern Alignment section.

Flow P and Flow Q in data-flows.md cover all multi-store edge cases documented in the plan: store-order priority, legacy-mode fallback, VALIDATION_ERROR for unregistered repos, MULTI_STORE_AMBIGUOUS for cross-store detect collisions, and the read-only invariant for collation operations.
